$comment: Documented exceptions to the text-size guard (scripts/type/check-text-sizes.mjs). Every entry needs a reason and, where an invariant exists, a test. Adding an entry requires design review. Allowed kinds: 'em' = parent-relative text-[Nem] (R1, with the R5 floor invariant); 'px' = px font sizes in CSS/inline styles/canvas (R3); 'svg' = literal SVG fontSize (R4). The 12px floor (R2) can NEVER be waived here.

src/components/wallboard/WallboardPanels.reason: Dispatch TV wallboard: the whole board is sized in em from ONE root font-size set by src/pages/WallboardPage.tsx so it scales from a 1080p to a 4K wall display.
src/components/wallboard/WallboardPanels.invariant: rootMinPx x smallest em multiplier in this file >= 12px. Verified by scripts/type/wallboard-floor.test.ts (parses both files).

src/pages/WallboardPage.tsx.reason: Owns the wallboard root font-size (style fontSize on the board container); its own headings are em multiples (>=1em) of that root.
src/pages/WallboardPage.tsx.invariant: Root minimum px (floor-derived, rem-based) x smallest em multiplier >= 12px. Verified by scripts/type/wallboard-floor.test.ts.

src/components/sketch/SketchCanvas.tsx.reason: Floor-plan annotation editor: labels are drawing content positioned in plan coordinates (SVG user units), not UI chrome; their size is tied to the plan scale.
src/components/sketch/SketchCanvas.tsx.invariant: Literal sizes are >= 12 (R2 still enforced). Rendered size can fall below 12px when the plan is zoomed out — see docs/design/TYPE_SCALE.md 'Known exceptions'.

src/components/brand/LogoConstruction.ts.reason: Brand-guidelines specimen: label text is drawn in logo-construction user units inside a large viewBox.
src/components/brand/LogoConstruction.ts.invariant: Literal size >= 12 (R2). Rendered size depends on the specimen scale (documentation page only).

src/components/documentTemplates/Documen.reason: WYSIWYG preview of a printable document template at fixed px dimensions; rem would change what the document looks like on paper.

src/components/signatures/SignaturePad.t.reason: Typed-signature preview rendered in a handwriting face at a fixed decorative size (the signature artwork, not UI text).

src/lib/dvir.ts.reason: Canvas 2D font for rasterising a typed signature into the DVIR PDF; canvas pixels, not CSS.

src/pages/TrustBadgeSettingsPage.tsx.reason: Pixel-exact preview of the embeddable trust badge, which is rendered by third-party sites at fixed pixel dimensions (w x h).
src/pages/TrustBadgeSettingsPage.tsx.invariant: Literal sizes >= 12 (R2). The embed itself is produced elsewhere and is NOT covered by this guard.
